name: @ai-study/desktop
description: AI 组件生成器 — Electron 桌面壳层

scripts.build: esbuild src/main/index.ts src/main/spawnServer.ts src/main/spawnGenerator.ts src/main/waitForPort.ts src/main/lifecycle.ts src/main/windowState.ts src/preload/index.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron
scripts.build:watch: esbuild src/main/index.ts src/main/spawnServer.ts src/main/spawnGenerator.ts src/main/waitForPort.ts src/main/lifecycle.ts src/main/windowState.ts src/preload/index.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --watch
scripts.build:all: pnpm build:embedded && pnpm build:main && pnpm build:dist
scripts.build:embedded: pnpm --filter @ai-study/shared build && pnpm --filter @ai-study/server build && pnpm --filter @ai-study/generator build
